entities.name: Keruga
entities.description: Legendary dinosaur hippo of Ikoria, regarded as a great sage.

entities.name: Rielle
entities.description: Sage who considers Keruga a great sage like herself.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker taken by Rielle to meet Keruga.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Keruga fought in defense of Ikoria.

events.quote: she took the planeswalker Vivien Reid to a meeting with the monster
